name: subtract the projections onto the previous vectors, then normalise
mechanism: take the vectors in order; from each, subtract its projection onto every vector already processed so that what remains is perpendicular to all of them, then scale it to unit length; the spans are preserved at every prefix

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Gram–Schmidt process' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Linear algebra: orthogonalizes a set of vectors

fails_when: orthogonality is lost in floating point unless the subtraction is done one vector at a time (the modified form)
